about.title: About Me
about.intro: I am a <1>Systems Engineer</1> with a passion for developing innovative solutions and working on complex systems. I completed my Master's degree in Systems Engineering with a focus on Automation and Robotics at the <3>University of Bremen</3>.
about.description: My journey in <1>software development</1> started during my bachelor studies, where I discovered my enthusiasm for embedded systems and system software. I enjoy tackling challenging problems and building efficient, scalable applications.
about.passion: When I'm not coding, I love exploring new technologies. Outside of tech, I'm a passionate runner and swimmer, like going cycling, and enjoy hiking in the mountains. Regular fitness training is also an essential part of my routine.
about.currentFocusText: Full-Stack Development with React, Node.js, and Cloud Technologies
